title: Compose live h1 class witness suffix
objective: Compose live prefix relation/HNF owners through exact bidirectional HNF witnesses, full Smith transforms, D=I binding, and transactional publication of vacuous h1 generator/order evidence without resident artifacts or expected matrices.

handoff.summary: Added a source-transparent native suffix that consumes only live relation, HNF, and HNF-transform owners; derives both relation/presentation maps and the full Smith transform; proves D=I and both transform inverse pairs; and transactionally publishes the matrices plus genuine empty h1 generator/order evidence. Focused CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged checks reject relation, HNF, transform, and nontrivial-class mutations without changing published owners.
risks: The result is internal PARI-correspondence evidence under the existing explicit factor-base/GRH assumptions, not a public class-saturation proof.
The integration base currently fails architecture:check on the pre-existing unclassified benchmark-only pari_h1_outcome_c_adapter.c file.
next_steps: Wire this suffix directly after the accepted prepared-root prefix and retain its transform and generator components in the unified immutable Output.
